stem: What is the author's primary purpose in writing the letter?

options.label: A
options.text: To explain why dogs are better behaved if they are used to being around people

options.label: B
options.text: To share information about a potential volunteer opportunity at the Medway dog park

options.label: C
options.text: To suggest that many dog owners do not give their pets an opportunity to exercise

options.label: D
options.text: To convince the town council that the citizens of Medway would benefit from a dog park
